about_the_game:
This Christian non-fiction visual novel is Quantum Soteriology and is for those 18+ only. And this is LGBT+ Affirming and Plural Affirming. Wiki:

Warning: Contains references to Anxiety and Asthma and Autism and Child Abuse and Corporeal Punishment and Depression and Hell and Mannerisms and Physical Abuse and Obsessive Compulsive Disorder and Self Harm and Scrupulosity and Social Anxiety and Suicide.

This is not fiction. And this is real, the story of over a decade of abuse experienced by this autistic plural trans lesbian Jaysa Jam. Zoom from Sept 17 2014 to present day. Gain a deeper appreciation of Christian theology through the lens of Infernalism, Annihilationism, Infernannihilationism and Universalism. Experience the accounts of the events as they unfold. Navigate and click through menus to unlock the secret behind the mystery.

And this is a reason to live. Read through character dialogue on specific timestamped dates and view logs of past conversations to learn what happened.

Become immersed in over 400+ songs ranging from lo-fi to symphonic metal. Experience heart felt interactions from your friends, delve into a deep web of complex lore. Collect items in your inventory. Play over 50+ minigames to earn points! Unlock gallery images! Be careful as you navigate through randomized backgrounds and hidden zany messages. Contrast real world history with biblical scripture.

Find the name of your abuser. Remember your backstory. And embrace a world with color. 

Survive in this gray bloodstained hellscape.
